verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that functions can be written in TypeScript, Python, or Go using an SDK, so multi-language authoring is covered for those three languages. Nothing in the pack shows feature parity across the SDKs, and the testing library and ESLint plugin cited are TypeScript-specific. missing for 10: evidence of real feature parity across SDKs, languages beyond TS/Python/Go, independent or hands-on corroboration of the non-TypeScript SDKs.
